Experimental Maven extension and Gradle settings plugin for browser-authenticated private Packages downloads. Both artifacts bundle shared authentication and proxy code and bootstrap anonymously from Packages.

Requires an explicitly configured native OIDC client with PKCE and refresh support. POSIX session storage; no Keychain integration. Gradle configuration cache, Maven 4, Windows and IDE imports are not qualified. Public publication does not activate private repository access or provision a production IDP client.

See README for setup, supported versions and limits. The attached archive preserves Maven publication files, sources, Javadoc and checksums.
